reason: We do library storytime, parks and church groups because they're free, and $59 a month is a lot on $48k. My baby is little and I'd worry about bigger kids running around, so I'd stick with free stuff.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? And I can't see paying $59 a month when the library and parks cost nothing.
would_change_my_mind: A separate, protected baby area or baby-only hours, plus a free first visit or a cheap drop-in so I can see it first.
